name: dns-empty-san-and-excluded-constraint-invalid
description: excludedSubtrees dNSName is 'example.com'. The leaf has a dNSName SAN whose IA5String value is empty (length 0). An empty dNSName is malformed per RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 (dNSName values must be IA5String preferred-name syntax host names) and must be rejected before constraint matching. A validator that admits the empty value into its constraint checking risks indexing into a zero-length string — Go 1.26 explicitly panicked on this combination (empty SAN reaching the wildcard-exclusion parent map, where `s[0]` ran past the buffer).
references: Go #77953 — empty DNS SAN crash in wildcard-exclusion path
notes: Companion to dns-empty-san-invalid which has the *permitted* constraint shape. This one specifically pairs the empty SAN with an excluded constraint to exercise the code path where Go 1.26 panicked.
Constructed via unknown_extensions raw DER because cryptography's DNSName API rejects an empty string. ascii2der payload: SEQUENCE { [2 PRIMITIVE] { "" } }.
